subject: RM_Garsulix
departures: Floats in mid-air with no wings: the body hangs clear of the ground and the legs touch nothing
The main body is one swollen, translucent, veined gas sac, much larger than any head or thorax, with no segmented insect body
Chitin plates cover only the top of the sac like a cap, and the veined sac shows below and around them
Hooked legs hang down from the underside of the sac, curled and dangling as if to grab, not planted or walking
A working mouth sits on the underside among the hanging legs, not on a separate head at the front
